derivation: Static scan of solution/ in the 13 subset tasks (container-s4/package-egress-hosts.json, 2026-11-04): agent-phase mechanisms apt (11), pip (3), uv (1) and solution-literal download hosts. Verifier-phase hosts (astral.sh) and build-time hosts (github.com) are deliberately absent: the verifier keeps Harbor's own uplink. To be confirmed by a logged oracle sweep through the proxy before any paid run. S9 (2026-11-07): download-r2.pytorch.org added as the measured redirect target of the allowlisted download.pytorch.org (a18da995 sweep, pytorch-model-cli). python-standalone.org + its measured redirect bucket added as the uv managed-Python mirror selected by agent_env (financial-document-processor); github.com stays denied host-wide (see denied_by_design).

rationale.archive.ubuntu.com: apt mirror of ubuntu:24.04 amd64 images (7 tasks)
rationale.security.ubuntu.com: apt security pocket of ubuntu:24.04 images
rationale.deb.debian.org: apt mirror (incl. debian-security) of debian:13.0-slim and python:3.13-slim-bookworm images (6 tasks)
rationale.download.pytorch.org: literal in pytorch-model-cli solve.sh (CPU wheel index)
rationale.download-r2.pytorch.org: documented CDN redirect target of download.pytorch.org wheel/metadata URLs (a18da995 sweep: pytorch-model-cli denied here, torch not installed)
rationale.python-standalone.org: python-build-standalone mirror named by agent_env UV_PYTHON_INSTALL_MIRROR; serves only /mirror/astral-sh/python-build-standalone/<tag>/<file> via a 302 to the bucket below; uv 0.8.14 verifies every artifact against its embedded sha256
rationale.pycdn-2025-03-02.oss-cn-shanghai.aliyunc: measured 302 target of python-standalone.org (uv 0.8.14 CONNECT log, 2026-11-07); bucket listing is AccessDenied and non-PBS paths 404

agent_env_rationale: Set identically for all seven arms (driver.package_agent_env). uv's default managed-Python source is github.com/astral-sh/python-build-standalone/releases/download, which would need github.com host-wide. Measured with uv 0.8.14 (the financial-document-processor image's uv): requests become <mirror>/<tag>/<file>; a valid-gzip wrong-bytes mirror is refused with a sha256 mismatch, so the mirror cannot change what uv installs. No task file is modified.

denied_by_design.github.com: would let any agent fetch Terminal-Bench's published tasks/solutions (contamination route); TLS is tunnelled, so a path-scoped github route would need interception
denied_by_design.objects.githubusercontent.com: GitHub release/LFS object host (reachable only via github.com redirects)
denied_by_design.release-assets.githubusercontent.com: measured redirect target of github.com release downloads (uv 0.8.14 CONNECT log)
